_: Tier-2 peer input for the ARCC / SCEM beta fallback. Produced 23-Aug-2026 by beta_regression.own_stock_beta(ticker, market='EG', exchange='EGX') — the sanctioned path, against the registered EGX30 regressor. NOT a decision: the peer-set definition is the open judgement, and whichever set is adopted becomes the precedent for every thinly-traded EGX name behind these two. Saved so the work is not recomputed when ARCC (queue #2) and SCEM (queue #7) come up in Wave 1.
why_tier_2: The hierarchy decides the TIER, not the analyst: tier 3 (beta = 1.0) applies only 'if neither the own-stock history nor a same-country peer set is available'. Eight same-country peers clear the usability gate, so tier 2 is the first available tier and tier 3 is not reachable.
subject_note: Both FAIL the own-stock usability gate against the real EGX30 — ARCC R2 0.047, SCEM R2 0.025, both under the 5% floor. Neither may keep its composite number.

construction_value_chain.note: Nearest by sector — building materials, cables and a contractor.

all_gate_clearing_egx_industrials.note: Every covered EGX industrial clearing the gate. Broader, more stable.

finding: The two candidate sets differ by roughly one point of beta, so the peer-set choice barely moves the answer — which is itself the useful result. Both raise beta above the failed own-stock and the retired composite numbers for ARCC and SCEM, so both fair values come DOWN either way.
still_to_do: These are EQUITY betas. Tier 2 as written requires the median UNLEVERED peer beta re-levered to the subject's target structure — unlevering needs D/E and the tax rate per peer, available in-repo only for the peers that carry a compute.py. Do that step at build time; do not shortcut it with the equity medians above.
